episodes.title: Summons
episodes.summary: After the mauled body of a girl shows up on the outskirts of Bear Valley in Upstate New York, Elena Michaels, the world's only female werewolf, is forced to choose between her new "human" life in Toronto with new love, Philip and her previous life with The Pack, at Stonehaven. Even though it's been a year since she abandoned her life among the werewolves, Elena still feels the sting of having forsaken her old world, while trying to build a new and "normal" life.

episodes.title: Prodigal
episodes.summary: At Stonehaven, Elena tracks the killer Mutt, while avoiding the advances of Clay Danvers, her former lover. Haunted by her own past as a killer, Elena is desperate to get back to her human life, but is delayed when a second body is discovered, this time on Stonehaven property.

episodes.title: Trespass
episodes.summary: Tension grows between the Pack and angry locals when another victim is discovered. Meanwhile, old chemistry resurfaces as Elena and Clay work together to track the killer Mutt to a warehouse rave.

episodes.title: Grief
episodes.summary: While tensions grow between Elena and Clay, Jeremy sends the pair to track a new Mutt threat. Their investigation reveals that this Mutt threat may be less random than they first thought.

episodes.title: Bitten
episodes.summary: As Elena struggles to defend Clay against suspicions of murder, old memories of their past are stirred up. Former Pack member Daniel Santos arrives at Stonehaven with information about the Mutt uprising.

episodes.title: Committed
episodes.summary: Back in Toronto, Elena’s commitment to Philip is tested and her life interrupted when Santos makes an unwelcome appearance. At Stonehaven, Jeremy’s title is challenged, forcing him to fight to maintain his status as the Alpha.

episodes.title: Stalking
episodes.summary: The Pack accepts the Mutts’ offer to discuss a truce. But the meeting proves to be anything but what they were expecting. In Toronto, Philip reconnects with a former flame.

episodes.title: Prisoner
episodes.summary: Jeremy has difficulty recovering from his injuries, forcing Clay to viciously interrogate a Mutt in the War Room, while Elena confronts a woman who wants nothing more than to be just like her.

episodes.title: Vengeance
episodes.summary: The pack must put personal issues aside when they’re faced with a new threat – one that has ties to the former Pack Alpha. Nick learns more about his father’s past. Logan is faced with a difficult decision when he receives an unexpected gift.

episodes.title: Descent
episodes.summary: Elena’s worlds collide when Jeremy orders Clay to accompany her to Toronto for protection. An unexpected survivor is able to give the Pack valuable new information about the Mutts.

episodes.title: Settling
episodes.summary: Elena attempts to rebuild her relationship with Philip after he learns that she hasn’t been entirely truthful with him. With the Pack divided on either side of the border, the Mutts make their move.

episodes.title: Caged
episodes.summary: Frantic with worry, Elena disobeys Jeremy’s command and goes on a solo mission. Later, when Philip confronts her about who (or what) she is, Elena is forced to choose between her two worlds.

episodes.title: Ready
episodes.summary: Having learned the truth about her werewolf origins, Elena reunites with the Pack to prepare for a final stand against the Mutts.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.summary: Elena and The Pack are on the hunt for Malcolm. Meanwhile, back at Stonehaven, Jeremy receives an ultimatum from the Council of International Alphas that challenges his leadership over North America.

episodes.title: Scare Tactics
episodes.summary: Clay investigates a mysterious symbol that may be related to witchcraft.

episodes.title: Hell's Teeth
episodes.summary: A new threat proves to be more powerful than anticipated; the pack and coven suffer heavy losses.

episodes.title: Dead Meat
episodes.summary: Elena awakens to find herself the subject of painful tests in a hidden compound run by a maniacal and powerful cult leader. Meanwhile, The Pack and witches must resort to dark magic in an effort to track down their missing members.

episodes.title: Rabbit Hole
episodes.summary: In order to stay alive, Elena must guide Dr. Bauer through her first Change as The Pack and Coven try to figure out who Aleister is, and where his compound is located.

episodes.title: Nine Circles
episodes.summary: Aleister casts a mind-bending spell on Elena, forcing her to battle her dark fears and demons.

episodes.title: Bad Dreams
episodes.summary: The Pack has things under control when the Council of Alphas reassembles at Stonehaven until a surprise visit from Savannah upends their plans. Meanwhile, Nick and Paige inadvertently bring danger to a loved one's doorstep.

episodes.title: Dark Arts
episodes.summary: Having possessed Clay's body, Aleister returns to Stonehaven where he creates ideal conditions to abduct Savannah. Meanwhile, Clay finds himself trapped in his unconscious, wrestling with both the occupying Aleister and his own mind in a way that could destroy him.

episodes.title: Scavenger's Daughter
episodes.summary: With Aleister's Undoing spell underway, Elena, Clay, Paige and Nick try to find him only to discover Aleister's sinister endgame for Savannah once the Undoing is complete. Meanwhile, Jeremy helps Ruth delve into Left Hand magic in order to take down Aleister from afar, and Logan spirals into his own dark corner after Rachel delivers some devastating news.

episodes.title: Fine Temporum
episodes.summary: Elena and The Pack storm the Delphi building to save Savannah, the witches, and the werewolves in a final showdown against Aleister and Clara.

episodes.title: Family, of Sorts
episodes.summary: To solidify his power, Jeremy tasks Elena, Clay and Nick to recruit all North American Mutts; Elena is accosted by a mysterious family with a surprising claim.

episodes.title: Our Own Blood
episodes.summary: Elena struggles to deals with a mysterious werewolf claiming to be her father; Clay readies Stonehaven for a possible attack from the Spanish.

episodes.title: Right Behind You
episodes.summary: Elena struggles to convince Jeremy to protect her blood family against the Russia Alpha; Nick uncovers Roman's plans.

episodes.title: A Quiet Dog
episodes.summary: Jeremy attempts to broker a negotiation to end the 30-year blood feud between Sasha and Roman. Meanwhile, Elena watches over Pack prisoner, Konstantin, who tries to deduce why she is protecting Sasha.

episodes.title: Of Sonders Weight
episodes.summary: Jeremy faces the fallout of failed negotiations between Roman and Sasha, who, in other events, tells Elena the truth about abandoning her 30 years ago as she helps him back to health. Meanwhile, Clay and Alexei track down the victim of a young wolf's attack.

episodes.title: Rule of Anger
episodes.summary: Elena and Clay team up against a deadly new foe as they attempt to save the imprisoned Marsten; while at the same time, Paige and Nick work together to figure out what is causing the magical outbreaks from Rachel's baby; and Katia does something desperate to save her family.

episodes.title: On the Brink
episodes.summary: Nick, Paige and Rachel use magic to track Katia after she kidnaps baby Rocco; Elena asks Konstantin to meet with her at Stonehaven in order to discuss ending the blood feud and calling off the Russian assassin; and only more bloodshed results from Clay and Jorge keeping an eye on the Albino.

episodes.title: Tili Tili Bom
episodes.summary: As the Alpha, Elena sets out with Clay to take down the Albino; Nick and Katia are captured by Roman's henchmen; Jeremy gets help from a surprising ally in his quest to kill Roman.

episodes.title: Shock the System
episodes.summary: When Elena tries to comfort a grieving Sasha, they get lured into the woods and are taken prisoner by the Albino; Jeremy wages psychological warfare against his captor; Clay, Nick and Alexei race to save a new Alpha.

episodes.title: Truth, Changes, Everything
episodes.summary: Elena comes up with a dangerous plan to take back Stonehaven, save the Pack, and change everything forever.
